name: harbor-docs-copilot
description: MCP-free retrieval tools for GitHub Copilot: look up specs, generated code maps, spec-to-code locations and the architectural graph instead of dumping files into context.

harborDocs.docsRepoPath.description: Path to the OKF docs bundle (harbor-docs), absolute or relative to the first workspace folder.

harborDocs.generatedPaths.description: Folders containing generated code maps (backend/frontend), absolute or relative to workspace folders.

harborDocs.maxResultChars.description: Hard cap on characters returned by any tool call (token budget).

harborDocs.graphPath.description: Path to graph.json from scripts/gen-graph.ps1. Empty = <docsRepoPath>/generated/graph/graph.json.

chatParticipants.name: docs
chatParticipants.description: Answer from specs and generated maps; cite spec IDs and file:line

commands.name: spec
commands.description: Find and summarise a spec/calculation by ID or keywords

commands.name: where
commands.description: Where is a spec ID implemented (backend/frontend)?

commands.name: impact
commands.description: Blast radius of a change across backend, frontend and docs

languageModelTools.name: harbor-docs_docsLookup
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the OKF docs bundle (index.md files first, then concept frontmatter) for a spec ID, calculation ID or keywords. Returns matching concept paths, type, status, trust badge and the first section of the best match. Use before reading any source code.

query.description: Spec ID (P1-001), calculation ID (monthly_projection) or 2-5 keywords

section.description: Optional heading to return instead of the first section, e.g. 'Business rules' or 'Computation'

languageModelTools.name: harbor-docs_codeMap
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return rows from the generated code maps (api-index, events, db-schema, jobs, codebase-map, components, routes, types-index, docs-tags) that match a query. Cheap alternative to searching or opening source files. Returns table rows with file:line locations.

query.description: Path fragment, operationId, topic, table, context, class, component or symbol

languageModelTools.name: harbor-docs_specToCode
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Resolve a spec or calculation ID to the exact code locations tagged with @docs <ID> in the backend and frontend repos (from docs-tags.md). Returns declaration, summary and file:line so only those ranges need to be opened.

id.description: Spec or calculation ID, e.g. P1-001 or monthly_projection

languageModelTools.name: harbor-docs_impact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Blast radius of a change using the generated architectural graph (contexts, endpoints, classes with depends-on edges, Kafka topics, tables, frontend features/routes, spec IDs). Input a node id (endpoint:GET /api/v1/session/product1/overview, topic:harbor.market.prices-updated, table:meeting_session, spec:P1-001, class:Product1Manager, context:product1, feature:product1), a substring, or a changed file path. Returns neighbours by depth, the edges, and the spec IDs affected. Use for impact analysis, work-item scoping and test-case scoping instead of searching the code.

target.description: Graph node id, substring, or repo-relative file path
